_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gold-miner signals with Newmont's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Newmont is one of the world’s largest gold producers and is the only gold company included in the S&P 500 Index and Fortune 500, and was the first gold company included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Index-World.' 'Our business is dependent on the price of gold and copper, which are affected by numerous factors beyond our control.' 'A substantial or extended decline in gold or copper prices would have a material adverse effect on Newmont.' (the FY2009 10-K's own words; it does not call the business cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule)

classification.quality_note: 'Newmont is one of the world’s largest gold producers and is the only gold company included in the S&P 500 Index and Fortune 500, and was the first gold company included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Index-World.' 'Our business is dependent on the price of gold and copper, which are affected by numerous factors beyond our control.' 'A substantial or extended decline in gold or copper prices would have a material adverse effect on Newmont.' (the FY2009 10-K's own words; it does not call the business cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.18x; -23% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.91; conservative 2yr +196%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -36.2%/yr (worst year FY02-FY09 ex-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +30.7%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.8-yr ex-FY07 median

BULL.desc: EPS +37.4%/yr (FY02-FY09 ex-FY07 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +80.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY09 ex-FY07, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEM (retrospective, 2010-10-15) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.18x (70.8% downside to Bear $18.09 / +402.1% upside to Bull $310.68) | Adj composite 3.18 vs market 1.27: gap +1.91 [UNDERVALUED] | -23% above the EPP floor $80.40 (30x FY10E $2.68) | Conservative 2-yr case: +195.9% total (+98.0%/yr) | At 23.1x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $81.84 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +34.4% YoY in Q2 2010, forward revenues +34.4% (Q2 2010 revenue growth (no revenue guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
